title: Lesion-aware visio-linguistic context regularization for radiology report generation

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Lesion-aware visio-linguistic context regularization for radiology report generation》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】While Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized image captioning, their direct application to radiology report generation (RRG) faces two key challenges: the semantic dilution of lesion features due to indiscriminate global image encoding, and the stylistic drift resulting from LLMs' lack of strict clinical constraints.
